{
  "candidate_rtl": "module ticket_machine #(
    parameter ON  = 1'b1,
    parameter OFF = 1'b0
) (
    input  clk, clear, ten, twenty,
    output reg ready, dispense, return_sig, bill
);

    localparam RDY    = 6'b000001,
               DISP   = 6'b000010,
               RTN    = 6'b000100,
               BILL10 = 6'b001000,
               BILL20 = 6'b010000,
               BILL30 = 6'b100000;

    reg [5:0] State, NextState;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (clear) begin
            State <= RDY;
            bill  <= OFF;
        end else begin
            State <= NextState;
            case (NextState)
                BILL10, BILL20, BILL30: bill <= ON;
                default:                bill <= OFF;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always @* begin
        ready      = OFF;
        dispense   = OFF;
        return_sig = OFF;
        case (State)
            RDY:  ready      = ON;
            DISP: dispense   = ON;
            RTN:  return_sig = ON;
            default: begin end
        endcase
    end

    always @* begin
        case (State)
            RDY: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = BILL10;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = BILL20;
                else
                    NextState = RDY;
            end
            BILL10: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = BILL20;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = BILL30;
                else
                    NextState = BILL10;
            end
            BILL20: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = BILL30;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = DISP;
                else
                    NextState = BILL20;
            end
            BILL30: begin
                if (ten)
                    NextState = DISP;
                else if (twenty)
                    NextState = RTN;
                else
                    NextState = BILL30;
            end
            DISP, RTN: NextState = RDY;
            default:   NextState = RDY;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
",

However, the new bill-register input path can become critical, and synthesis can change the mapping. Strict WNS improvement and non-regressing TNS must be established by EDA against the frozen baseline.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds one logical flip-flop and moves the bill decode to its input, with synchronous-clear handling. The available area headroom is 25.27424 um^2; fitting within it is not established. Accept only if mapped area is at most 278.01664 um^2 and the timing objective passes. No new clock, memory, latch, or asynchronous reset is introduced.",
  "functional_boundaries": "After the specified reset edge, bill equals the original decode of State: reset sets State to RDY and bill to OFF; every subsequent edge loads State from NextState and bill from the decode of that same NextState. Arbitrary later synchronous clear assertions preserve this relationship. The ten-over-twenty priority, native interface, parameter declarations, other outputs, and cycle-level latency are unchanged. No startup assumptions are added. Formal equivalence against the frozen original under the supplied startup contract remains required."
